name: Terudo
description: Official hosted MCP server for Terudo, travel data eSIMs for travel businesses (agencies, visa services, tour operators, travel apps) that resell them under their own name. Quote a trip, check before selling whether the traveller's phone takes an eSIM and whether their French mobile plan already covers the destination, then create orders, follow eSIMs and top them up; webhooks and monthly statements with a partner's secret key. Auth: Authorization: Bearer header with a Terudo API key; public demo key pk_test_terudo_demo_public (catalogue, quotes and checks, no payments). Official MCP Registry id com.terudo/partner.
